note.question: How do strategic customers and unknown, markovian demand affect revenue-maximizing mechanisms?
note.overview: The paper shows that appropriate dynamic pricing strategies can be used to draw benefits from the presence of consumers who strategically time their purchase even if the arrival process is not known. In our model, a seller sells a stock of objects to a stream of randomly arriving long-lived agents. Agents are privately informed about their values, and about their arrival time to the market.
